name: 3D Print
description: Export the selection or the whole model as 3MF or STL for a slicer (Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer, Cura): millimetres, Z up, any scale, welded and repaired into watertight solids, checked against your printer's build volume, stood the way each piece prints best and laid out on the plate, around the areas the printer keeps clear for itself.
author: MatthiasDM
